defects.justification: fastapi>=0.110 is an open lower bound with no upper pin or lock file.
uvicorn>=0.29 is an open lower bound with no upper pin or lock file.
python-multipart>=0.0.9 is an open lower bound; it parses untrusted multipart bodies and has had DoS advisories, so the version should be pinned.
httpx>=0.27 is an open lower bound with no upper pin or lock file.
pillow>=10.1 is an open lower bound that also admits Pillow releases with known decoder CVEs fixed later (e.g. 10.1/10.2); the image decoder for untrusted input should be pinned.
pytest>=8.0 is an open lower bound with no upper pin or lock file.

Every distinct uploaded or fetched image creates a new cache directory with up to 10 rendered files, with no eviction, quota or authentication, so any client can fill the disk by posting varied images.

URL fetches (each buffering up to 20 MiB) run before and outside the render semaphore, and uploads are read fully into memory too, so concurrent requests have no global bound on memory or threadpool slots.
httpx timeout=10.0 applies per connect/read operation, not to the whole download; a remote server trickling bytes can hold a worker thread for a very long time while staying under the 20 MiB cap.
